It addresses the difficulty of manually selecting corresponding regions in 3D volumes for color transfer.
By using Gaussian clustering and area-based mapping, it automates the process of transferring color characteristics from 2D illustrations or photographs to 3D volumes.

The method is particularly useful in medical and biological fields where photographic volumes are available or where scalar volumes (like CT scans) need to be colorized based on illustrative examples.
